translations.ctemDesign.subtitle: Prioritize findings, review evidence, and drive remediation and verification.
translations.ctemDesign.metricsHelp: The source provides an open-finding total, not a complete lifecycle summary or history. Missing progress, verification and completion totals are shown as unavailable, never inferred from a loaded page or a repair claim.
translations.ctemDesign.focusSubtitle: Start with the highest-ranked findings in the source's current priority order.
translations.ctemDesign.focusScope: Source priority order · not a weekly change calculation
translations.ctemDesign.noAlert: This finding has no linked alert record. Per-alert fix generation and history are unavailable; the original evidence remains available.
translations.ctemDesign.proposalHint: Generate a repair proposal for this alert. This does not apply a change or confirm remediation.
translations.ctemDesign.proposalReview: Review the proposal before applying any change.
translations.ctemDesign.requestFailed: Could not load this record. Retry without losing the selected finding.
translations.ctemDesign.chooseFramework: Choose a framework to export its existing evidence binder.
